title: Where It All Began
text: Ceylon Sharks was founded in Singapore in 2019 by Subodana Herath, together with a group of Sri Lankans living in Singapore who shared one common passion — cricket. Being away from home, cricket was more than just a sport. It brought us together, helped us build friendships, kept us connected to our Sri Lankan roots and created a community where we could enjoy the game we all loved. Subodana served as the founder and first captain of Ceylon Sharks from 2019 to 2021, helping establish the team and laying the foundation for the Sharks identity and brotherhood. Those early years marked the beginning of a journey that would later take the Sharks through multiple divisions of competitive cricket in Singapore.

title: A New Chapter
text: In 2022, Ceylon Sharks regrouped and began a new chapter under the captaincy of Hasitha De Silva. With a renewed squad, fresh energy and bigger ambitions, the Sharks returned to competitive cricket while carrying forward the foundation established during the team's early years. The objective was simple — build a committed team, enjoy our cricket, compete hard and move forward together.

title: Deluxe Division Champions
text: The Sharks began their journey in the Deluxe Division, and 2022 became one of the defining years in our history when we were crowned Deluxe Division Champions. It was the team's first major championship and a significant moment in the Ceylon Sharks journey. The championship also marked the beginning of our climb through the divisions: Deluxe Division → Premier Division → Elite Division → Supreme Division.

title: Building Momentum
text: Following our success in the Deluxe Division, Ceylon Sharks progressed to the Premier Division. Every promotion brought stronger opponents and tougher challenges, forcing us to improve both individually and collectively. The Sharks continued to build a culture based on teamwork, commitment and fighting for one another until the very last ball.

title: An Unbeaten Season
text: The 2024 season became another unforgettable chapter in Ceylon Sharks history. The Sharks produced an outstanding campaign, finishing the league unbeaten and at the top of the table. It was one of our strongest seasons and reflected how far the team had progressed since restarting its competitive journey in 2022. During our journey, the Sharks also had the privilege of participating in a Guinness World Record cricket event in Sengkang, adding another memorable moment to our story.

title: Premier Division Runners-Up
text: 2025 brought another major achievement as Ceylon Sharks finished as runners-up in the Premier Division. The Sharks fought their way through the competition, winning the knockout stages and earning a place in the Final. Although we fell short of lifting the championship, reaching the final and finishing as runners-up represented another important step forward for the team. The journey continued, taking Ceylon Sharks into the Elite Division and eventually to another major milestone — the Supreme Division.

title: Four Divisions. One Journey.
text: From starting in the Deluxe Division to reaching Supreme, every step represents the contribution of the players and leaders who have been part of Ceylon Sharks. Deluxe → Premier → Elite → Supreme. From our beginnings under founder and first captain Subodana Herath, through the team's restart in 2022 under Hasitha De Silva, the Sharks have continued to grow while carrying forward the same passion that brought everyone together in 2019.

title: More Than a Cricket Team
text: Today, Ceylon Sharks represents much more than cricket. What started as a group of Sri Lankans living in Singapore coming together through their love of the game has grown into a brotherhood and a cricketing family away from home. Championships and promotions are important parts of our history, but the friendships, memories and people who have represented the Sharks are what truly define our journey. Every player who has worn the Sharks jersey has contributed to our story. From our founding in 2019, our restart and Deluxe Division Championship in 2022, an unbeaten campaign in 2024, Premier Division Runners-Up in 2025, and our progression through Deluxe, Premier, Elite and Supreme, the Sharks have come a long way. But our story is still being written. We continue to compete, grow and create memories together while staying true to the values that brought Ceylon Sharks together in the first place. We respect our opponents. We play for each other. We fight until the last ball. One Team. One Dream. Ceylon Sharks.
